instruction: Add a new sheet named "Overview". Merge cells A1, B1, and C1 together and write "Data Overview". Then merge cells A2 and B2 for "Time Period" and merge cells C2 and D2 for "Interest Rate".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new 'Overview' sheet with merged cells A1:C1 containing 'Data Overview' as a title, merged cells A2:B2 with 'Time Period', and merged cells C2:D2 with 'Interest Rate'. Evaluator verifies the sheet exists, all merged groups have the correct text, and boundary cells (D1, E2) are NOT merged.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - new 'Overview' sheet creation, three merge groups (A1:C1, A2:B2, C2:D2), and correct text values ('Data Overview', 'Time Period', 'Interest Rate').

Correct logical implementation: The metric function properly handles partial credit by tracking value_score and merge_score separately (lines 43-57), awarding 0.5 points for each aspect when both are specified. The previous critical flaw with the 'continue' statement has been fixed.

Semantically correct expected rules: A1 contains the value 'Data Overview' and is marked merged=true, while B1 and C1 (part of the merge range A1:C1) only need merged=true. This correctly reflects LibreOffice Calc's merged cell behavior where only the top-left cell holds the value.

Proper getter logic: Uses openpyxl to extract cell values and merge status by checking if each cell coordinate is in any merged range (ws.merged_cells.ranges). This correctly identifies all cells within a merged range as merged=true.
Defensive boundary verification: Includes checks for D1 (merged=false) and E2 (merged=false) to ensure no over-merging occurred, preventing false positives.

Appropriate postconfig: Activates the LibreOffice Calc window, saves the file with Ctrl+S to persist changes, and includes sleep delays for stability. This ensures the getter reads the correct persisted state.
